interface.longDescription: Search primary legal materials, retrieve source metadata and excerpts, analyze aggregate patterns, and trace relationships among laws, decisions, citations, and legislative history. Ten provider-neutral legal workflows are included; more are available from the public Legalcode plugin repository.
defaultPrompt: Research an Icelandic legal issue using current legislation and case law, with citations to the primary sources.
Find the EU legislation and decisions relevant to a legal question, then trace any national implementation measures.
Compare primary legal authorities across two jurisdictions and explain the material differences and coverage gaps.
